clue.text: See pruned plant grafted to grape

indicators.note: pruned means cut back, so the word See loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as the word see itself
a plant is a factory or works, such as a mill
to can mean on, as when a door is pushed to or a shirt is on

explanation.surface: A gardener is told to look at a cut-back plant that has been grafted on to a vine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pruned' trims SEE to SE; 'grafted' simply joins the pieces. Plant is a factory here, not something growing.
explanation.definitionFit: Semillon is a white wine grape variety grown widely in Bordeaux and Australia.

clue.text: Intelligence facility described in text

indicators.note: described in means drawn within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: SMS is a text message
facility means skill or knack, which is art

explanation.surface: An intelligence service's building is mentioned in a message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'described' has the old sense of drawing a line around something; facility is a talent, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Smarts is informal for brains or cleverness.

clue.text: Couple is clothed by a tailor in arranged appearance

parts.note: to couple is to pair or mate

indicators.note: clothed by means wrapped inside the letters that follow
arranged means put in a new order, so these letters are shuffled

parts.note: taken as the letters of these three words
taken as the word is

explanation.surface: A pair are dressed by a tailor for a formal appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' yields RIALATION; 'clothed by' wraps it round the pair of letters. Couple is a verb, to pair up.
explanation.definitionFit: A materialisation is something appearing in bodily form, like a ghost.

clue.text: Music beats

definitions.meaning: short phrases played on a guitar or other instrument
defeats or thrashes, as in gives someone a licking

explanation.definitionFit: Licks are short instrumental riffs; and to lick an opponent is to defeat them.

clue.text: Open broken vent with weak hand

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: to vent is to air, express openly

explanation.surface: Smash open a vent with a feeble hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' turns OPEN into ONEP. Weak hand is a poker hand.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker a hand with only two cards of the same rank ranks low.

clue.text: Religious instructors travelled through water next to island

parts.note: to swim is to travel through water, past tense swam

explanation.surface: Holy teachers swam across to reach an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Swamis are Hindu religious teachers or holy men.

clue.text: Trying to have on one a little

parts.note: to have clothes on is to wear them
I is the Roman numeral for one
some means a certain amount, a little

explanation.surface: Trying to put a little on oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trying or tedious is tiring to put up with.

clue.text: Mocking sinners changed direction, expecting trouble

indicators.note: changed means altered, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

parts.note: S, for south, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: Sinners mocking others had a change of heart, sensing trouble ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges MOCKING SINNERS, then S (south) ends it. Expecting means pregnant.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea in early pregnancy is a common affliction of a woman who is expecting.

clue.text: Reserve time in coastal area

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: the seaside is the coast

explanation.surface: Booking a holiday at the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: To set aside money is to keep it in reserve.

clue.text: A gunboat finally changed course and fired weapons

indicators.note: finally picks the very last letter of the word gunboat

parts.note: a sailing boat that changes course into the wind has tacked

explanation.surface: A gunboat turned at last and opened fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To attack is to assault an enemy, here by firing weapons at it.

clue.text: Go down hill after par and birdie

indicators.note: after places the second piece behind the word par

parts.note: taken as the word par
to go downhill is to decline or decay, which is to rot

explanation.surface: A golfer's round slips away after a par and a birdie.
explanation.walkthrough: Par and birdie are golf scores in the surface; here birdie is just a little bird, and 'Go down hill' is read as one idea, decline.
explanation.definitionFit: A parrot is a bird, and birdie is a playful word for any bird.

clue.text: Watches first and last parts of a three-part series

indicators.text: first and last parts of a three-part
indicators.note: the word series is split into three equal pairs and only the outer two are kept, dropping its middle pair

explanation.surface: Someone views the opening and closing episodes of a three-part TV series.
explanation.walkthrough: Split SERIES as SE-RI-ES and keep the first and last parts.
explanation.definitionFit: To see a show is to watch it.

clue.text: Members of faculty researched rubber rings

indicators.note: Members of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: University staff have been studying rubber rings.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyres are the rubber rings fitted round the wheels of a vehicle.

clue.text: Expert, in case restricted by obligations, becomes sour

parts.note: an ace is an expert at something

indicators.note: restricted by means held in, so one piece is enclosed by the other

parts.note: ties are bonds or obligations
if can mean in case, as in take a coat if it rains

explanation.surface: A specialist, bound by duties, grows bitter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restricted by' gives TIFIES. The comma after Expert is only punctuation for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To acetify is to turn to vinegar, so the liquid turns acid and sour.

clue.text: A person who refuses to eat more quickly

definitions.text: A person who refuses to eat
definitions.meaning: someone going without food is fasting
the comparative of fast, at greater speed

explanation.definitionFit: One who fasts abstains from food; and the comparative of fast means at greater speed.

clue.text: Section of frame is tall and black in colour

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a tone is a shade of colour
high means tall
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Part of a picture frame is tall and coloured black.
explanation.walkthrough: Frame means the human body's skeleton, not a picture frame.
explanation.definitionFit: The femur is one bone of the skeleton, the body's frame.

clue.text: Far side of woods, stripped of trees, is hit hard

indicators.note: the far side of a word is its last letter, taken from woods

parts.note: land that has been logged has had its trees felled

explanation.surface: The far side of the forest, cleared of timber, has been badly hit.
explanation.definitionFit: To slog is to strike a ball or opponent with great force.

clue.text: Chickens situated outside base distracted old VIPs

indicators.note: situated outside means placed round the outside of the next piece

parts.note: hens are chickens

indicators.note: distracted means scattered, so the letters of base are rearranged

explanation.surface: Chickens around a military base bothered some former dignitaries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distracted' yields ASBE; 'situated outside' wraps the chickens round it. Base looks military but is just fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Former celebrities who are no longer important are dismissed this way.

clue.text: Racket concealed by a big firm

indicators.note: concealed by means tucked inside the words that follow

parts.note: taken as the letters of the two words
a racket is a din, a loud noise

explanation.surface: A large company is hiding a criminal scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: Racket reads as fraud in the surface, but it is noise, DIN. 'Firm' is the adjective, not a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm and lasting both describe something steadfast and enduring.

clue.text: European not carrying an undesirable micro-organism

indicators.note: not carrying means dropping, so the following letters are removed

parts.note: a German is a European
taken as the word an

explanation.surface: A European who is free of an unwelcome bug.
explanation.definitionFit: A germ is a microbe that causes disease.

clue.text: Divine relic excited head of church

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters of relic are rearranged
head of takes the first letter of the word church

explanation.surface: A holy relic thrilled the leader of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A divine is a clergyman or theologian, a noun sense of the word.

clue.text: Established standard in drug, an analgesic

parts.note: a code is an established set of standards
taken as the word in
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An approved standard for a painkilling drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Codeine is an opiate used as a painkiller.

clue.text: Emergency vehicle losing a passenger is used repeatedly

indicators.note: losing means giving up, so the following letter is taken out

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
the letter a is carried inside the word car, like a passenger

indicators.note: used repeatedly means the word appears twice in a row

parts.note: taken as the word is

explanation.surface: In an emergency, a vehicle drops off a passenger again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' drops the letter riding inside the vehicle, its passenger; 'used repeatedly' doubles the short word.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a time of intense danger or difficulty.

clue.text: Soap, viewed in bed, went on and on

indicators.note: viewed in means seen inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: taken as the word bed
lather is soap worked into a foam

explanation.surface: Someone watching a soap opera in bed talked endlessly about it.
explanation.walkthrough: Soap suggests a TV serial, but here it is LATHER.
explanation.definitionFit: To blather is to talk at length without much sense.

clue.text: Pushy person is game

definitions.meaning: one who pokes or prods, someone who pushes
a card game played for bets

explanation.definitionFit: One who prods others is literally a poker; and poker is a gambling card game.

clue.text: Cut up a snapper's tail frozen

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to lop is to cut

indicators.note: tail picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A fishmonger chops up a snapper's frozen tail.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar regions are icy cold, so the word describes freezing conditions.

clue.text: One responsible for leader travelled around carrying it

indicators.note: carrying means holding something inside, so one piece contains the other
around means turned round, so this word is read backwards

parts.note: to travel on horseback or by vehicle is to ride, past tense rode
taken as the word it

explanation.surface: A man drove a leader around, carrying something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' yields EDOR; 'carrying' holds the pronoun inside. A leader is a newspaper's leading article.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper's chief writer of opinion pieces is in charge of its leading article.

clue.text: Condition backed by seniors and team players

indicators.note: backed means turned back, so this word is read in reverse

parts.note: if introduces a condition
elders are older people, seniors

explanation.surface: A condition supported by the older members and the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Fielders are the members of a cricket or baseball side who field the ball.

clue.text: Picks up a selection of delicatessen's escargot

indicators.note: selection of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone chooses a few snails at the deli.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up a signal or a smell is to detect it, to perceive it.

clue.text: Hybrid flowering plants sprang up in chaff mostly

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other
mostly means all but the last letter of the word

parts.note: to chaff is to tease playfully
to rise is to spring up, past tense rose

explanation.surface: Crossbred plants shot up among the husks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' yields TEAS; 'in' puts the flower's verb inside. Chaff is the verb, to banter, not husks.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea roses are a class of hybrid garden roses with a scent likened to tea.
